William Dean Howells, Indian Summer.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-dean-howells/indian-summer

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Dean Howells, the author, died 1920.

First publication of the text used: Indian Summer was published in 1886 by William Dean Howells.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1886, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below). A work published in 1886 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 1982.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last died in 1920), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
